decisions.summary: A pre-existing defect fixed under constitution XIV: door_path, where the law refuses the first path (straight step, or the 4 ft route pulled taut), now tries a route at the law's own gap; seed 33's row farm reached
decisions.why: The GM asked for the implementation to match the research; this moves door_path toward 0081 ('runs straight wherever it can keep its usual clearance from fences') and 0246 (a lane's middle 7 ft off a garden fence) and narrows nothing. A defect found in the work at hand is fixed in it (XIV), as waves 87 and 88 were. Reviewer re-ran make cohort N=1 SEED=33: 7/7 passed.

decisions.summary: Order: per target, nearest first (the existing six), the first path is tried before the law's-gap route; the fallback at a nearer target is preferred over the first path at a farther one
decisions.why: Keeps every path the law already accepted at its target; preferring the nearer target serves 0081's 'a worn path takes the shortest way', the claim door_path carries. Not an exception: nothing is excluded from the law.

decisions.summary: The fallback is routed at WEB_FABRIC_GAP (7 ft) and pulled taut only where Lawful.on_lawful_ground keeps each step
decisions.why: 0246's own figure and the law's own ground half; the taut pull is bounded by the research's clearance rather than overriding it, which is what 0081's drawing page says.

decisions.summary: route_from_door takes the gap as a parameter, default FOOTPATH_FABRIC_GAP (4 ft) unchanged; the 4 ft footpath deviation is not moved this wave
decisions.why: Plumbing for W89-3; the 4 ft hold is pre-existing (wave 4, spec Review history item 4) and its own ranking row (119, DRIFTED, kept) stays open for its wave under FR-006 - this wave does not carve it out of scope.

decisions.summary: Kashikawa: one door path (lanes[9]) re-placed, added to the declared 'village lane on kashikawa' occasion (now naming waves 88 and 89) for a glyph-check at batch 11's close; four maps unchanged
decisions.why: Feature 294's occasion rule as applied every batch. MEASURED by the reviewer (HEAD vs working-tree manifest): only lanes[9] pts[1] and pts[2] moved, 4-5 px; its nearest garden 9.28 -> 10.78 ft, so it was already lawful and 'off a fence' means further off, not a fence fault cured. The Occasions line names wave 89 but its text after the colon still describes only wave 88's road - a wording gap, not a narrowing.

decisions.summary: A Decisions Recorded row in spec.md, class HISTORICALLY ACCURATE (0246), pointing at serve.py door_path, with m:wave89-door-path-at-the-law-s-gap; wave 88's row gains its cohort count
decisions.why: FR-008 owes a row for a fix that changes what a map draws (Kashikawa moved). The claim on door_path rests on 0081's drawing page (claims-index), which states the same clearance rule; the class holds on either page.
